newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - GILTS TO BALANCE ON 114-00 BARRIER.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - GILTS TO BALANCE ON 114-00 BARRIER.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE are poised for consolidation on Tuesday, and have established a base at 114-00, technical analysts said.
"Gilts are due for one to three days' consolidation, after we broke out of a key trendline a few weeks ago," said Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London.
"We have been building it up again near 114-00, which is a really key trigger. Below that, we can go half a point lower, and then a point lower."
September gilts closed at 114-08 on Monday, after trading an inside day. The contract opened at 114-11 on Tuesday.

In the short term, the gilt future has scope to climb to 114-18/21, Miller said. "That's an area of congestion and highs and lows." Beyond there, Friday's high of 115-08 would be hard to break, she added.

"The market needs to claw its way back through 114-24 resistance and close back through 115-00 for a reasonable promise of short-term excitement," said a technical analyst from a European bank in London in a note to clients.
"That said, there hasn't yet been a bearish signal, such as a close under 114-00." the analyst added, suggesting the contract has potential to 116-00 and beyond.
December short sterling futures were unchanged at 0710 GMT at 92.63.
